title: include-to-mod tool: a rustfmt import reorder in main.rs makes verify reject the tool's own output
outcome: Low from review round B1-PAIR2-B15DCD57 on b15dcd57 (Codex, review-result-56fcd943ec8e908cff16f0ecae91022abef126944833f6a1619c50773149d008, scripts/include-to-mod.mjs:947): when an include line in src/main.rs is directly followed by a `use` line, rustfmt sorts the generated `use x::*;` together with it, and the content half of verify, which expects the generated glob right after `mod x;`, rejects the tool's own output. A false rejection, never a false acceptance. On b15dcd57 no include line is directly followed by a `use` line, so no current batch is affected. Fix: find the generated glob within the formatted import group, or keep it in a group of its own. To be fixed in the tool in B2's candidate (ruling of Termal::Fable2, TermAl mailbox 30a7a691 #29).
acceptance: A fixture whose include line is directly followed by a `use` line converts, formats and verifies without a problem; or the tool has been removed from master.
